svg.title: Probation + Undertaker architecture
svg.desc: Cloud Run logs feed a nightly census that files candidate issues. The Undertaker Duo flow (exhume, bury, coroner) opens a deletion MR. The MR pipeline runs verify, secure, SCI and the Probation gate, which reads policy.yml and the ledger. After merge, a release child pipeline deploys to staging, waits for approval unless Hands-off, sends 10% canary traffic, soaks with synthetics, then promotes or rolls back and reverts. Settle jobs score the ledger branch, which feeds the Probation Board and the Probation Clerk agent through an MCP server.

text.font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, 'DejaVu Serif', serif
'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: An agent that may only delete dead code, and a deterministic pipeline that decides how far each deletion goes alone.
